name: EURUSD M30 SELL pullback candidate E2-S v0.2
status: research candidate; development-qualified; later consistency gate failed due Jul-Aug win rate and sample size

state_contract.touch: High >= EMA20 and Close <= EMA50 within trend. Start only on a new touch run after a non-touch bar whose Close < its EMA20. Consecutive touches update last_touch; keep used flag.
state_contract.confirmation: While active and unused, at most 3 bars after latest touch: Close < Open; body >= 0.4 ATR; CL <= 0.35; Close < EMA10 and preceding Close >= preceding EMA10; 0 < (EMA20-Close)/ATR <= 1.0. Require 6 contiguous source bars.
state_contract.deduplication: First passing candle only per pullback episode; skip at least 12 subsequent bar positions after a signal (index distance >12). A native timestamp gap resets episode and cooldown. New touch run requires preceding non-touch and preceding close below EMA20.
state_contract.expiry: Invalidate when trend gate fails, when more than 3 bars after last touch, or on gap. Consumed episode cannot confirm again.
state_contract.entry: next contiguous M30 open; cancel observed gap; pending if absent. Cancellation consumes signal and cooldown.
state_contract.outcome: primary Close[i+12] from entry Open[i+1]; no stop loss, take profit, position size or live execution specified
state_contract.indicator_init: same EMA/ATR seeds as baseline, new EMA200 seeded at first source close; all normalized slopes use 3 transitions/ATR
